data.one_liner: A simple multiselect dropdown widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It provides a concise way to create a multi-select ComboBox or SelectBox widget in Flutter. It allows users to pick multiple options from a dropdown list and displays the selected values.
use_when: You need a straightforward multi-select dropdown widget in your form.
You want to allow users to select multiple items from a list with minimal setup.
avoid_when: You need complex form builder integrations or advanced custom validations not provided by the widget.
You require extensive UI customization beyond the documented parameters.
strengths: Very easy to set up and use with minimal boilerplate.
Supports generic types and custom value separators.
weaknesses: Relies on states_rebuilder which might not fit every app's architecture.
